name: Can I view off-market properties without being pre-approved for a mortgage?

mainEntity.name: Can I view off-market properties without being pre-approved for a mortgage?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's possible to view some off-market properties without pre-approval, many sellers and their agents will require proof of funds or a pre-approval letter before scheduling a showing. This is particularly true for high-value properties or in competitive markets where sellers want to ensure serious buyers. Obtaining mortgage pre-approval demonstrates your financial readiness and commitment, which can significantly enhance your credibility and access to exclusive off-market listings. It also helps an agent like Kelby Contreras to accurately gauge your buying power and focus on properties that truly fit your budget, streamlining the search process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Some off-market properties can be viewed without pre-approval, but many sellers require proof of funds or pre-approval to ensure serious buyers.
